# Quaternius: Universal Animation Library 1 and 2 (Standard)

By Quaternius (https://quaternius.com), **CC0 1.0**: see `LICENSE.txt`.
Sources: https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-animation-library and
https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-animation-library-2 (Standard editions,
free).

`mocap.res` is an AnimationLibrary of 28 of their clips, retargeted onto the
KayKit rig that every hero and enemy uses. It is made by
`tools/anim/fetch_ual.py` (download) and `tools/anim/retarget_ual.gd`
(retarget); do not edit it by hand. `docs/ANIMATION.md` explains it.
